name: libero_spatial: initial observations
featureDescription: 104D = frame-0 observed robot state (8D) + 4x4 area-average RGB from the initial agent and wrist cameras (48D each, divided by 255). A simple visual baseline, not a semantic image embedding. No actions, future images, or target outcomes are used.
source: Local public LIBERO LeRobot v3 dataset; only episodes present in the atlas action sample.
